name: Cat GPS Tracker with Fridge Display

mentions.name: Cat GPS Tracker with Fridge Display
mentions.description: This is a subscription-free GPS/GNSS tracker for cats that wander outside, paired with a screen that hangs on the fridge to show where the cats are at all times (like a Marauder's Map). All location data stays local. The underlying tech is planned to be extended to other products such as a watch for adults and a kids tracker.
mentions.problem: Existing pet trackers require monthly subscriptions, and the builder needs to keep tabs on cats that like to wander outside.
mentions.source_excerpt:
building a GPS tracker for my cats who like to wander outside.

some features:

- no monthly subscriptions

- location via GPS/GNSS

- a screen that hangs on my fridge (akin to marauders map, to see where the cats are at all times)

- the location data stays local always.
